title: 2019-03-22 Cost management and follow up for public cloud in IPEX
content:
Date

Attendees

Goals

There has been a discussion lately with regard how we at IPEX level can get an overview of costs generated by cloud solutions. This meeting is to align on the topic and discuss next step, as well as look at  that  created for how IPEX can monitor costs related to cloud. Goal is to decide next steps().

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes
5min Show how we use Grafana to monitor AWS costsName

This could be used for Azure as well. The plugin for Azure is in a beta state though. Grafana can be hosted as an application on Azure. In the future this could be a task for DEXF team to manage. 



We could forward this type information to Analytics in the future


At IKEA IT the management of accounts was handled in a similar way of what we are doing right now i.e. internal list. We do not have that many accounts so this way of doing ti should be sufficient. will update  to hide decommissioned accounts. In the future we could create form to order account and be able to automate e.g. addition of cost monitoring service.

Action items

1 complete Investigate what it takes to deploy Grafana to Azure and connect cost moudles for a Azure account and a AWS account. 41 complete Update  with rationale for evaluating Grafana  42 complete will update  to hide decommissioned accounts.
